source.note: Kenney hatchback-sports (FBX, like car-sports-sedan and car-sedan from the same kit, so the three read as one set). Hot-hatch height 1.4 m; stylized proportions: at that height it is 3.63 m long and 1.65 m wide. Cream body (the sports sedan is white, the sedan red) so a street can mix all three; the source's amber lamps are mapped to the white lamp role. maxColors 12 so the amber lamps get their own cluster. Wheels are separate nodes in the source; static, no clips.
